encounter.title: Prologue 3 — Time Has a Cost (5x5 Candidate A, seed 132)
encounter.notes: LD-005 Prologue 5x5 Candidate A. Board: square5 (5x5), seed 132, 6 arrows (N0 E3 S2 W1). Mob on East, 3 HP, ATTACK IN 4, dmg 2. Clean 0-damage sequence: #3(S) -> #0(E) -> #5(E) -> #4(E) kills the mob on turn 4 exactly before it strikes. Wasting a turn taking #1(W) causes boss to fire for 2 damage.
